system-cost-breakdown/1.formula: sum over the carrier's Generators, Links, StorageUnits, Stores, Lines and Transformers of c x nom_opt, c = (overnight_cost x CRF(rate, lifetime) if overnight_cost is set, else capital_cost) x nyears + fom_cost x nyears, nyears = sum of objective weights / 8760
system-cost-breakdown/1.validity: verified LP solve and finite, non-negative objective weights (else unverified_solve); whole horizon only (else whole_horizon_required); n.objective recorded and finite (objective_not_recorded); objective scale exactly 1, from the live sentinel or the recorded solver config; an automatic scale counts as unknown (objective_scaled); no objective constant, recorded or from an extendable asset's existing capacity (objective_constant); no PCS/STATCOM, reserve or commercial objective terms (extra_objective_terms); no committable or modular extendable unit (mip_solve); no quadratic, storage, spill, stand-by, start-up, shut-down or curtailment cost, no inactive asset and no composite asset (unmodelled_cost_terms); an overnight_cost has a discount rate and a positive lifetime (annuity_inputs_missing); finite capacities, costs and dispatch (invalid_or_missing_raw_data); extendable capex plus all opex equals n.objective within RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE x max(1, |objective|) (objective_mismatch). Refusals: ambiguous_carrier, unknown_carrier, unsupported_carrier_population, unsupported_snapshot_scope (multi-period or scenario network)
